description: This file defines an Angular component for the note editor page, handling note display and updates via the NotesService, and routing logic.

classes.name: NoteEditorPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing a specific note, managing route parameters, and communicating with the NotesService.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changing the title of the note, calling the notes service to update.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Handles changing the content of the note, calling the notes service to update.

methods.name: onTagsChange
methods.description: Handles changing the tags associated with the note, calling the notes service to update.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current note through the notes service and navigates back to the notes list.
